# Security Policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

## Supported scope

Security reports should concern repository-authored scripts, workflows, packaging, or documentation in the current default branch. Upstream model/runtime vulnerabilities should also be reported to the relevant upstream project when appropriate.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not publish exploitable details, credentials, tokens, private URLs, or sensitive user data in a public issue. Use GitHub's private security-reporting mechanism when available, or contact the repository owner through the contact information already published in repository metadata.

Include the affected path/version, reproduction steps, impact, and any safe proof-of-concept details needed to understand the issue.

## Response expectations

Reports will be reviewed on a best-effort basis. This project does not promise a fixed response or remediation SLA.

## Secrets

No credential is required to be committed to this repository. If a token is accidentally exposed, revoke or rotate it immediately and remove it from all reachable history before publication.
